title: The Ship Going the Other Way
old_p1: Jonah was a prophet, a man Heavenly Father sent to tell His words. Heavenly Father said, “Go to Nineveh.” Nineveh was a big city of the Assyrians, who had been enemies of Jonah’s people.
Jonah did not want to go. He went to Joppa, a town by the sea, and got on a ship going far the other way, to Tarshish.
old_p2: Out at sea a great wind blew, and the waves grew tall. The sailors, the men who work on a ship, threw their heavy things over the side to make it lighter.
Jonah was fast asleep down inside the ship. The captain woke him and said, “Get up and pray!”
Even far out at sea, Heavenly Father knew right where Jonah was. Snuggle in and feel it: He knows where you are tonight too.
p1: Heavenly Father spoke to Jonah. He said, “Go to the big city of Nineveh.” Jonah was to tell the people to stop doing wrong. But Nineveh’s people were enemies of Jonah’s people.
Jonah did not want to go. So he ran away! He got on a ship sailing the other way.
Out at sea, a great wind began to blow. The waves grew big. The sailors were afraid.
p2: But where was Jonah? He was down inside the ship, fast asleep! The captain woke him up. “Get up,” he said, “and pray!”
Jonah tried to run away, but Heavenly Father still knew right where he was. He always knows where you are too. Tonight you can whisper, “Heavenly Father, help me listen to You.”
